literal_meaning: মুখে জল দেওয়া (giving water to the mouth)
figurative_meaning_en: Giving Ganges water to the mouth at the time of death
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মৃত্যুকালে পরিবারের সদস্যরা মুখে জল দিয়ে বিদায় জানাল।
পুরনো রীতি অনুসারে মুখে জল দেওয়া হয়েছে, এবার শান্তি পাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: At the time of his death, family members gave water to his mouth as a farewell rite.
Following the old custom, water was given to his mouth; now he will find peace.
history: This idiom stems from the ancient Hindu practice of offering Ganges water to the dying, believed to purify the soul and ensure moksha or liberation from the cycle of rebirth.
note: The idiom specifically invokes the sanctity of Ganges water in Bengali Hindu culture.
